text: がんばる　パソコンマニアや！

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: がんばる　パソコンマニア
patterns.explanation: A verb put right before a thing describes that thing. がんばる　パソコンマニア = 'a PC maniac who works hard'.

patterns.name: 〜だ
patterns.explanation: や is the Kansai dialect form of だ, 'is'. パソコンマニアや = 'he's a PC maniac'.
